deep.reconstruction:
This page holds draft sentences for the opening sections of Riemann's 'Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen' (Crelle 54, 1857). Those sections are 'Allgemeine Voraussetzungen und Hülfsmittel' and the analysis-situs lemmas. There is no computation on the page. It has three blocks.

(A) Top block, heavily reworked. It introduces the branched covering surface. Riemann says that for certain investigations, notably of algebraic and Abelian functions, it is necessary (or useful) to represent the branching of a many-valued function geometrically. The final form is: 'Nach Einführung einer ... die Art ihrer Verzweigung darstellenden Fläche kann diese mehrwerthige Function als eindeutig bestimmte Function des Orts in dieser Fläche betrachtet werden.' He rewrites this as: 'Die mehrwerthige Function hat für jeden Punkt einer solchen ihre Verzweigungsart darstellenden Fläche nur einen bestimmten Werth und kann daher als eine eindeutig bestimmte Function des Orts in dieser Fläche angesehen werden.' In modern terms: a multivalued analytic function w(z) becomes a single-valued function on its Riemann surface, a branched cover of the z-plane.

(B) Middle block, after a struck first attempt. Let T be a surface covering the (x,y)-plane simply or multiply, with arbitrary boundary. Let X and Y be functions of position on T that are continuous everywhere on T (the published text says 'stetige'). Suppose X dx + Y dy is everywhere an exact (closed) differential, so that
  dX/dy - dY/dx = 0.
A struck earlier version wrote the condition as an equation dX/dy = dY/dx. This is the hypothesis of the lemma that follows in the published paper. There, ∫(X dx + Y dy) taken around the boundary of any piece of T is 0, by Green/Stokes:
  ∮_{∂T'} (X dx + Y dy) = ∫∫_{T'} (dY/dx - dX/dy) dT.
Hence the integral from a fixed point is a single-valued function of position on a simply connected surface.

(C) Lower block, fragmentary. Insertions read 'die nicht einfach zusammenhängende [Fläche]' and 'Durch Querschnitte ... in eine einfach zusammenhängende zu verwandeln'. This is the step in which a multiply connected T is cut by cross-cuts (Querschnitte) into a simply connected T'. On T' the integral of a closed differential is single-valued. Across each cut it jumps by a constant: the period, or modulus of periodicity.

The last line, roughly 'Es ... für die ... Integrale ... gestalt[en?]', is illegible. Below it are only a few marks and a struck word.

Context: the previous page drafts the Dirichlet-principle existence statement with prescribed boundary and discontinuity conditions. The next page drafts the variational integral ∫((α_x)^2+(α_y)^2) dT and the section title 'Bestimmung einer Function einer veränderlichen complexen Größe durch Grenz- und Unstetigkeitsbedingungen'. Together these are preparatory drafts of the 1857 paper's §§1–3.
errors: No mathematical errors. The integrability condition dX/dy - dY/dx = 0 is the correct condition for X dx + Y dy to be closed (locally exact).

Calling X dx + Y dy 'vollständiges Differential' globally is justified only after cutting T into a simply connected surface. Riemann's own next step (Querschnitte) addresses exactly this, so it is not an error in context.
The continuity hypothesis on X, Y (present in the published version) is not clearly legible here. It may be among the illegible or struck words.

results.what: Representation of a many-valued function as a single-valued function of position on a branched surface covering the plane (the 'Fläche, die die Verzweigungsart darstellt')
results.modern_name: Riemann surface of an analytic/algebraic function (branched covering)
results.usually_credited_to: Riemann, Dissertation 1851 and Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen 1857

results.what: Condition dX/dy - dY/dx = 0 for X dx + Y dy to be an exact differential on a covering surface T, leading to vanishing boundary integrals
results.modern_name: Closed 1-forms / Green's theorem / Poincaré lemma (local exactness)
results.usually_credited_to: Classical (Euler, Clairaut, Green); in this surface setting Riemann 1857

results.what: Rendering a multiply connected surface simply connected by cross-cuts so that integrals of closed differentials become single-valued
results.modern_name: Canonical dissection by cross-cuts; connectivity / first homology; periods of integrals

deep.surprise_reason: These are drafts of the published opening of Riemann's 1857 Abelian-functions paper (Riemann surface concept, exact differentials, Querschnitte). The material is well known and already his. The page contains no new mathematics.

checkable.asserts: If X=dF/dx and Y=dF/dy then dX/dy - dY/dx = 0 (exactness implies the integrability condition)
X dx + Y dy = dθ satisfies the closedness condition on the punctured plane (a non-simply-connected region)
The closed form dθ has nonzero period 2π around the unit circle, so cross-cuts are needed for single-valuedness (illustration, mine)
Green's theorem on the unit square: boundary integral of X dx + Y dy equals the double integral of (dY/dx - dX/dy). This is the basis of the lemma the page sets up.

transcription_corrections: The top line written over the printed header likely reads 'namentlich für die Behandlung algebraischer u. Abel'scher Functionen ist es nothwendig' (cf. published 'Für manche Untersuchungen, namentlich für die Untersuchung algebraischer und Abel'scher Functionen ...'). The transcription's 'wesentlich' is probably 'namentlich'.
The struck line '[-Für manche Untersuchungen ist es nothwendig, die-]' is consistent with the published opening sentence.
The inserted '{+nicht+}' above 'Verzweigungsart' is doubtful. It is more likely 'art' completing 'Verzweigungsart'.
'kann folgendermaßen geometrisch dargestellt [werden]' is plausible; the published text has 'in folgender Weise geometrisch darzustellen'.

In the middle block, the struck clause after 'Fläche;' likely reads 'welche allenthalben der Gleichung ∂X/∂y = ∂Y/∂x ... genügen'. The surviving text is 'dass in dieser Fläche allenthalben X dx + Y dy ein vollständiges Differential, also ∂X/∂y - ∂Y/∂x = 0 ist'.

The fragment 'die nicht einfach zusammenhängende' is an insertion belonging to the following line: 'Durch Querschnitte die nicht einfach zusammenhängende [Fläche] in eine einfach zusammenhängende zu verwandeln'.
The number '144' at the right margin is the folio number, not part of the text.
